raise_justifications.backend/utils/apps.py: Username allocation becomes a SETNX claim instead of check-then-act, and paid-app entitlement gains a revocation path.
raise_justifications.backend/utils/conversations/process_conv: Conversation finalization owns the transcript-to-memory transaction across canonical and legacy paths, so it supplies the shared dev-only allowlisted capture observer with the accepted-write result; cassette bounds, redaction, and export remain in testing.parity_pack_v0.live_capture.
raise_justifications.backend/utils/memory/canonical_consolida: Candidate selection, bounded retry leases, atomic promotion planning, and batch-level duplicate-supersede rejection remain one canonical long-term admission authority; extracting them would permit competing admission state machines (FC-split-mutation-authority).
raise_justifications.backend/utils/memory/canonical_memory_ad: Canonical conversation replacement coordinates source-generation fencing, bounded lineage discovery, and atomic replacement application; splitting this state machine would duplicate lifecycle authority (FC-split-mutation-authority).
raise_justifications.backend/utils/other/storage.py: Signed-URL cache keys now include the bucket, which nine buckets previously shared.
raise_justifications.backend/utils/sync/pipeline.py: The v2 upload path now derives its on-disk name server-side instead of from the client filename, which allowed traversal into another tenant's staging directory.
raise_justifications.backend/utils/retrieval/tools/calendar_t: Confirmation gates before inviting a non-contact address and before a range delete, which previously wiped every event in a window with no prompt.
raise_justifications.backend/utils/llm/conversation_processin: New file entry: marketplace-app-authored prompt text is now XML-escaped and delimited as untrusted data instead of concatenated above the user's transcript.
